items.label: Confirm remote eligibility
items.detail: Record an employer source for Bangladesh or confirmed contractor eligibility.

items.label: Verify time overlap
items.detail: Convert expected working hours into UTC and Asia/Dhaka and confirm expectations.

items.label: Ship a Python backend service
items.detail: Share tests, migrations, API contract and a clean staging run.

items.label: Publish the enterprise RAG case study
items.detail: Report retrieval and answer quality, permission tests, release criteria and known limits.

items.label: Publish production evidence
items.detail: Include traces, load envelope, cost, recovery and current security boundaries.

items.label: Prepare the .NET transition story
items.detail: Use one concrete ERP or transaction example, then show its Python or AI equivalent.

items.label: Write a role-specific resume
items.detail: Map three job requirements to verified work or clearly labeled portfolio evidence.

items.label: Record an English introduction
items.detail: Explain your contribution, outcomes and next role in 90 seconds.

items.label: Complete two independent mocks
items.detail: Cover Python, SQL, RAG, security, system design and operational ownership.

items.label: Attach an asynchronous handoff
items.detail: Write a concise design decision and a production incident summary for remote review.

items.label: Build a remote application pipeline
items.detail: Save qualified roles, proof links, feedback and next follow-up dates.

items.label: Review application outcomes
items.detail: Use recurring feedback to revise the study plan and portfolio.

items.label: Collect senior ownership evidence
items.detail: Demonstrate outcomes over releases, repeatable mentoring and operational decision ownership.
